title: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 30% Cashback on Minimum $50 Spend, Capped at $150 Per Member @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 30% Cashback on Minimum $50 Spend, Capped at $150 Per Member @ TopCashback AU

[maruko] Is there a maximum spend limit. Or only the max cashback limit of $150
[tightarse] Hi. Woolies has removed its maximum spend threshold via TopCashback for Everyday Market (used to be $1000). So you can spend what you like above $50, however the maximum cashback you'll get from this promo is $150. Cheers!
[ozsingh83] I genuniney got excited as I wanted to get this for 997 less 30% discount but bugger, there is a 150 cap
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/972004
[gdogdiggity] Excellent ill be looking for a galaxy fe or a pixel a!
[excite] Also looking at galaxy s25 fe, would be $450 after cashback, if buying directly from Samsung, would be ~$465 after 6% cashback and Amex $100, wondering if it's better buying directly
[Stoptheban] Spent $800, tracked $150 cashback in 30 minutes. Showing as pending on my acc now 👍🏻
[Tanvry] So something in the $500 range basically maximises the value and becomes $350 after cashback
[EBC] Nice, had a $500 order (well $499.98) that I needed to make.

$277 tracked at $83.10. Was curious if anyone posted it as i got the topcashback notification. Ozb didn't disappoint
[EBC] Mind sharing the link? Mine tracked at $0 and I'm wondering if maybe the one I did wasn't eligible for some reason.
[tightarse] If it tracked at $0 cashback, one of the terms was broken (code use etc). Please see the terms in this post. Cheers.
[EBC] Thought I followed everything to the letter…
Any idea on the below? Bought two.
https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1129870865…
[tightarse] @EBC: Ah! I know what's wrong. Do you see 2 line items in your account? One would be for the 2 items you purchased with $149.99 cashback, and the other would be a random Woolworths Groceries item with $0 cashback. This happens if/when you accidentally navigate to the groceries store. Nothing to worry about provided you have the main Everyday Market purchase in your earnings page. Please let me know.
[EBC] @tightarse: Ah there we go. It was just groceries but the $149.99 just popped up as tracked. Thanks!
[tightarse] @EBC: No worries at all. Glad to hear it's ok. If it's really annoying you, ping me your TCB email address and I can remove the redundant groceries one for you so it's no longer visible. All the best!
[Doctorbevan] Hi TA, bought an item from a pool store, ensured I didn’t accidentally add any codes or anything else as per terms. Tracking as zero probably means it’s not looking good right?
[tightarse] @Doctorbevan: Hey Doc! Sounds like you have the same non-issue as EBC above. Are there 2 line items in your earnings page (Groceries & Everyday Market)? If so, you have nothing to worry about provided the Everyday Market line item shows cashback. Do let me know.
[Doctorbevan] @tightarse: Mate apologies, yes that’s exactly what has happened. It’s just popped up, the zero dollar groceries one threw me.
Sorry to annoy you on what is a busy night no doubt. Much appreciated as always for your dedication
[tightarse] @Doctorbevan: All good. If you want the groceries one gone, just let me know. All the best.
[cheapass88] https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1113551177…
I didn't use any coupons or credits. Just paid outright 277

I am sure I did not break any of the terms. No discount applied. Bought from Everyday Market Partner "Beville Official". Payment of the full amount by credit card. Did not purchase any groceries.
@tightarse what could have gone wrong?
[team teri] No, ordered on my laptop. No VPN. Pihole was (and still is) disabled.

[tightarse] @team teri: I have a feeling this may have happened to you. Please wait to see if Everyday Market tracks - I can see the API stalled at 9:24PM so any orders after this time aren't pulling through to us from the affiliate network (they're not lost, just delayed). Once it resumes, hopefully everything will be ok.
[team teri] @tightarse: Thanks! Here's hoping. The line I see does indeed say "Woolworths Groceries".
And just now the second line came through, $119.70. Thank you so much for this cracker of a deal!
Breville Infuser for $280 delivered (after cashback), that must be an all time low :-)

[team teri] So just confirming: this works, and tracks. And makes for some fantastic Breville deals!
